music.prompt: Modern, warm, light tech ambient bed for a friendly product explainer. Soft analog synth pads, a steady gentle pulse from a muted kick and soft shaker at 100 BPM, a light plucked arpeggio, warm sub bass. Optimistic and calm, never dramatic. No vocals, no lead melody that competes with a narrator. Present and audible throughout, consistent energy, a gentle lift every half minute, resolves warmly at the end.

sfx-whoosh.text: A soft, airy cinematic whoosh transition, subtle and short

sfx-block.text: A low, muted digital thud, like a door locking shut in a clean UI, subtle

sfx-chime.text: A gentle, warm two-note confirmation chime, clean and minimal
